description: This file defines the Error package, including classes Error, Error::Simple, and Error::subs, providing object-oriented error and exception handling with syntactic sugar for try-catch-finally constructs, as well as error propagation and stack trace generation.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for errors and exceptions with methods for creation, stringification, stack tracing, and association with objects.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error representing simple error strings, with optional associated values.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides functional constructs for try-catch-finally error handling, including support for catch, except, otherwise, and finally clauses.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Provides hooks for handling warnings and die signals, generating call stacks and tracebacks.

methods.name: Error->new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Error object, capturing caller info, and optionally generating stack traces.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws an error, either existing or newly created.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Error object; syntactic sugar.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Error object; syntactic sugar.

methods.name: prior
methods.description: Returns the last error created or associated with a package.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears stored errors for a package or globally.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns a string representing the error's stack trace or context.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error with an object for propagation.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was triggered.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was triggered.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the error message text.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the error for string context.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an associated value with the error.

methods.name: Error::Simple->new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a simple error with text and optional value.

methods.name: Error::subs::try
methods.description: Executes a code block with exception handling, supporting catch, except, finally clauses.

methods.name: Error::subs::with
methods.description: Syntactic sugar: returns the clause as a wrapped code block.

methods.name: Error::subs::finally
methods.description: Defines a finally clause to execute after try or catch.

methods.name: Error::subs::except
methods.description: Defines error handlers keyed by error classes.

methods.name: Error::subs::otherwise
methods.description: Defines a clause to handle all other errors if no catch matches.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::DEATH
methods.description: Handles die signals, generating detailed error messages and stack traces.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::TAXES
methods.description: Handles warnings, appending call stack info.

methods.name: Error::WarnDie::import
methods.description: Sets up warning and die signal handlers.
